title: CPG Supply Chain Manager
description:
CPG Supply Chain Manager

Location: Remote (LATAM based)  

Employment Type: Full time

Salary: $35K USD


About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated, full time Supply Chain Manager to own demand planning, vendor management, and wholesale replenishment across our portfolio of consumer products brands. This is a company with multiple direct to consumer subscription brands, one single purchase DTC brand, and two wholesale brands sold through major retail partners.


This role sits at the center of our supply chain operations, working closely with our warehouse team, finance, and brand leads to keep inventory accurate, purchase orders on schedule, and reporting visible to leadership. You will be the person who catches a forecasting error before it becomes a stockout, who flags an FBA shipment deadline before it slips, and who builds the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership see inventory health at a glance across every brand and channel.


This is a dedicated, single client role. You will not be splitting your time or attention across other companies or accounts.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Order and Inventory Accuracy Across Channels

  • Own the process of pulling sales orders across all sales channels, including wholesale retail partners and marketplace channels, and ensuring inventory is accurately and promptly decremented as orders ship from our warehouse
  • Maintain a real time, accurate view of true available inventory at all times, since forecasting, reordering, and fulfillment decisions all depend on this number being correct
  • Review and reconcile weekly cycle count data provided by the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator against expected inventory levels based on sales order activity
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, tracing issues back to root cause, whether that is a sales order processing error, a receiving error, or a physical count error
  • Note: this role reviews and reconciles cycle count data but does not have supervisory authority over the warehouse coordinator, who reports separately to the Senior Operations Manager

Demand Planning and Forecasting

  • Analyze sales velocity across all DTC brands and forecast demand by SKU
  • Determine and execute reorder timing and quantities for DTC brands to avoid stockouts and overstock
  • Incorporate seasonality trends and channel performance data from ecommerce, Amazon, retail marketplace, and social commerce channels into forecasting and reorder decisions

Vendor, Production, and Purchase Order Management

  • Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations
  • Track supplier lead times and follow up on delayed shipments
  • Coordinate directly with our overseas production team on reorder needs, production timing, and inventory availability
  • Maintain steady vendor relationships and communication, particularly when timelines get tight

Marketplace Fulfillment Management

  • Own the shipment calendar and deadline tracking for inventory sent into third party fulfillment centers (including Amazon FBA), ensuring shipments are submitted on time to prevent sales disruption
  • Proactively flag potential shortages or overstock situations before they affect sales

Wholesale Replenishment

  • Track replenishment needs and inventory levels for our wholesale retail partners
  • Coordinate with wholesale retailer portals and contacts on stock levels, reorder timing, and order minimums
  • Ensure wholesale order planning accounts for retailer specific lead times and minimum order requirements

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain organized, accessible documentation for vendor contracts and communications
  • Maintain a formal reorder tracker and replenishment schedule, kept current and accessible to leadership
  • Build and maintain regular reporting on inventory health, discrepancy trends, and stock levels across all brands, giving leadership clear and reliable visibility
  • Proactively communicate inventory risks and planning recommendations directly to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked
  • Support cross functional projects tied to supply chain systems or reporting improvements


What We Are Looking For

  • Prior experience in supply chain management, demand planning, or inventory management, ideally spanning both DTC and wholesale or retail channels
  • Experience coordinating directly with overseas manufacturing or production teams, including production timing and reorder communication, is strongly preferred
  • Experience with Amazon marketplace operations, including FBA shipment coordination, is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working in Excel or Google Sheets for forecasting and reporting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with vendors, retail partners, and internal teams
  • A proactive, detail oriented mindset with genuine ownership over deadlines and follow through
  • Ability to work as a dedicated, full time resource for a single company
  • Comfort working independently in a remote structure with regular reporting cadence to leadership

﻿

Why Join Our Team

  • A stage of company where you will help build supply chain infrastructure and reporting from the ground up, not just follow existing systems
  • Full ownership of demand planning and wholesale replenishment across multiple brands
  • A collaborative, low ego team environment where your work has direct, visible impact
  • Steady operational culture that values reliable execution and clear communication

title: Financial Planning Manager
description:
Turn recurring reporting into a decision system.

Own management reporting, KPI dashboards, and forward-looking analysis for US leadership teams.

This is not a task-execution role. You will be expected to own outcomes, exercise judgment, improve how the work gets done, and communicate directly with senior stakeholders.


About MAVI

MAVI is an invite-only network connecting high-performing finance and accounting professionals with fast-growing US companies. Members are assessed for technical capability, communication, ownership, and leadership potential. Through MAVI, you work directly with finance leaders, own meaningful outcomes, and build a track record that can lead to increasingly senior opportunities.


What you'll own

  • Build and maintain executive, board, and investor reporting packages.
  • Develop KPI dashboards that connect operating metrics with financial outcomes.
  • Produce variance analysis and forward-looking commentary for monthly business reviews.
  • Partner with data, accounting, and functional teams to improve source-data quality.
  • Automate recurring reporting and reduce manual spreadsheet work.
  • Translate trends into concise actions, risks, and opportunities.


What makes you a fit

  • 6+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, business intelligence, or management reporting.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability; Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools are valuable.
  • Experience building reporting for executives, boards, or investors.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, KPIs, and variance analysis.
  • Able to distinguish meaningful signals from reporting noise.
  • Excellent written communication and comfort working with US stakeholders.


The seniority bar

  • You independently structure ambiguous business questions and turn them into decision-ready financial analysis.
  • You challenge assumptions constructively and can defend your recommendation with executives and non-finance leaders.
  • You build models and reporting frameworks that others can use—not one-off analyses that depend entirely on you.
  • You understand the business implication behind the numbers and communicate a clear point of view.


What success looks like

  • Leadership receives consistent, trusted reporting with less manual effort.
  • KPI and financial narratives clearly identify what changed and what to do next.
  • Data-quality issues are surfaced and resolved at the source.


Why join now

Deliver strongly in this scope and build toward FP&A Manager or Finance Business Partner opportunities across the MAVI network. Compensation is USD-denominated and aligned with experience, scope, and location. Working hours are designed around local schedules with reasonable, clearly defined overlap for US stakeholders.

title: Product Designer Mobile & Web | Remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.


The role


You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

  • Product discovery and exploring new ideas
  • Turning early ideas into clear user journeys
  • Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems
  • Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs
  • Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing
  • Designing across iOS, Android and web
  • Working with and improving our design systems
  • Working closely with developers throughout implementation
  • Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users
  • Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.


What matters to us


Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.

We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work . The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.


What we're looking for


  • Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer
  • A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on
  • Experience designing for mobile and web
  • Good understanding of iOS and Android UX patterns
  • Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping
  • Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing
  • Experience working with design systems
  • Comfortable working closely with developers
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work
  • Very strong attention to detail
  • Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table
  • Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly
  • Fluent English , written and spoken


The setup


  • Remote
  • Contractor / PJ
  • Monday to Friday
  • The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time , so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions
  • Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible


Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

You know that moment when a student finally nails a presentation they were terrified of? Or closes a deal they almost lost to a language barrier? That's what we do at YouAble - and we're looking for teachers who live for those moments.


We teach Business English 1:1 to executives across Brazil. No scripts. No generic curricula. Each student gets a learning path built around their actual job, their actual challenges, their actual goals.


The role:

  • Individual classes (30 or 60 min), ~25 hours per week
  • Track each student's progress and adapt constantly
  • Work closely with our coordination team on methodology


The deal:

  • R$ 60/hour (contractor)
  • 100% remote
  • Flexible schedule within morning (7AM-1PM) and evening (5PM-10PM) windows, Brasília time
  • Real growth opportunity as the company scales


You're a fit if:

  • Your English is fluent or native
  • You've worked in a corporate environment

description:

Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!

#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Avaliar riscos e controles internos, considerando risco inerente e risco residual ;
  • Analisar criticamente a relação Risco → Controle → Mitigação ;

  • Avaliar a suficiência, qualidade e aderência das evidências apresentadas;
  • Identificar gaps de controle e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Recomendar controles ou ações complementares quando necessário;
  • Interagir com gestores e áreas de negócio para compreender processos, riscos e mecanismos de controle;
  • Atuar de forma crítica e independente, indo além da execução de procedimentos previamente definidos.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com riscos, controles internos, auditoria ou áreas correlatas ;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de riscos e controles internos ;
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de risco inerente e risco residual ;
  • Capacidade de avaliar desenho e efetividade de controles;
  • Experiência com análise e validação de evidências ;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e senso crítico;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de questionar processos e controles de forma construtiva;
  • Capacidade de identificar inconsistências e gaps sem depender de um roteiro operacional detalhado.

title: Domain Expert
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly qualified Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across a wide range of academic, research, and industry disciplines to support the evaluation, testing, and improvement of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

In this role, you will leverage your expertise to evaluate AI-generated responses, design domain-specific prompts, identify knowledge gaps, and provide evidence-based feedback to improve the quality and reasoning capabilities of advanced AI systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create complex, domain-specific prompts to test LLM capabilities.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning, and quality.
  • Identify factual errors, logical inconsistencies, and model weaknesses.
  • Develop challenging test cases that expose model limitations.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based feedback to improve model performance.


Day - to - day task

  • Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty.
  • Compare multiple AI responses and rank them.
  • Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references.
  • Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or higher in any field.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional, research, or teaching experience.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.
  • Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.


Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Music
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


We are seeking a highly qualified Music Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in music will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse music-related topics.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering music theory, genres, composers, artists, music history, production, instruments, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Location: LATAM – Remote

Mode: Contract

Job Description:

Builds the agents, models, and integrations on the platform's templates — the hands that turn use cases into production systems.


What they'll do

  • Build and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows on the paved path (templates, pipeline, guardrails)
  • Write and run evals for everything built; no system ships without passing its suite
  • Integrate with GoodRx systems and data sources; instrument for cost and quality telemetry
  • Pair with business users to iterate quickly inside bounded scopes


Must have

  • 8+ years software engineering; 2.5+ building LLM applications in production (agents, RAG, tool use)
  • Strong Python/TypeScript; API craftsmanship; prompt and context engineering that survives contact with users
  • Can write LLM evals as part of building — non-negotiable
  • Ships fast without skipping guardrails


Nice to have

  • Retrieval/IR depth (for assistant-facing work); healthcare data handling; cost-optimization experience

title: Domain Expert Reviewer
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your subject matter expertise will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of academic, research, and industry disciplines.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts within your area of expertise.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional, research, teaching, or industry experience in your area of expertise.
  • Prior experience reviewing, evaluating, editing, or quality-checking domain-specific content is preferred.
  • Excellent written English communication and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify factual, logical, and contextual errors.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026



About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.



The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS. Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.



This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.



How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Sports
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Sports Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in sports will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a wide range of sporting disciplines.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering global sports, leagues, athletes, tournaments, rules, statistics, sports history, analytics, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Sports Management, Sports Science, Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, or other sports-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of sports, including familiarity with major leagues, teams, athletes, tournaments, rules, statistics, and key developments across one or more sports.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in sports journalism, sports media, sports content, research, analysis, reporting, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to assess sports-related information accurately.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)

title: Commercial and Business Development Lead (Bilingual)
description:
Position Overview


We are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Client Recruiting Lead to spearhead client acquisition, relationship management, and recruitment delivery across Brazil. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for winning new business, presenting recruitment solutions, managing client engagements, and ensuring successful execution of recruitment projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development skills with hands-on recruiting expertise. They are comfortable opening doors, closing new clients, leading client presentations, managing search delivery teams, and personally contributing to candidate sourcing and recruitment efforts when needed.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a growth environment, enjoys building client partnerships, and is willing to roll up their sleeves to ensure exceptional recruitment outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Client Growth


  • Identify, develop, and close new client relationships across Brazil.
  • Build a strong pipeline of prospective clients through networking, referrals, market mapping, and outbound business development activities.
  • Present recruitment solutions, service offerings, and engagement models to prospective clients.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and secure signed recruitment engagements.
  • Develop strategic account plans to grow and expand client relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional recruitment, talent advisory, RPO, executive search, or consulting services.


Client Relationship Management


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key client accounts.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with hiring managers, HR leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Conduct intake meetings to understand hiring needs, organizational structures, and business objectives.
  • Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and hiring recommendations.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction and retention.


Recruitment Delivery Leadership


  • Oversee the end-to-end recruitment process across assigned client engagements.
  • Ensure delivery teams meet quality, timeline, and hiring objectives.
  • Manage recruitment workflows, candidate pipelines, and client communications.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Lead recruitment strategy discussions and hiring progress reviews with clients.


Hands-On Recruitment


  • Personally manage and deliver key searches when required.
  • Conduct candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and assessment activities.
  • Support recruiters on difficult or high-priority assignments.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines within targeted industries and functions.
  • Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.


Market & Leadership Contributions


  • Stay informed on labor market trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring practices within Brazil.
  • Provide thought leadership and recruitment expertise both internally and externally.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and best practices across recruitment operations.
  • Mentor and develop recruiting team members as the business grows.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of recruitment, executive search, RPO, staffing, or talent acquisition experience.
  • Demonstrated success in business development and client acquisition.
  • Experience leading recruitment engagements and managing client relationships.
  • Proven ability to close recruitment projects and generate new business revenue.
  • Strong understanding of full-cycle recruitment and talent acquisition best practices.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience within a recruitment agency, executive search firm, or RPO environment.
  • Existing network of corporate HR and business leaders in Brazil.
  • Experience scaling client accounts and cross-selling additional service offerings.
  • Leadership experience managing recruiters or recruitment delivery teams.
  • Knowledge of recruiting across multiple industries and functional disciplines.


Success Measures


  • New client acquisition and revenue generation.
  • Client retention and account growth.
  • Cross-selling and expansion of existing accounts.
  • Successful delivery of recruitment engagements.
  • Time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and client satisfaction metrics.
  • Growth of the Brazil business and market presence.

title: Remote Senior Artist (Graphic Designer)
description:
About Turing

Turing is an AI-powered tech services company with a mission to accelerate AGI advancement and deployment by bridging the gap between global talent from 100+ countries and the world's best foundational LLM companies, by helping them improve performance through model evaluation, fine-tuning, feedback, factuality and handling diverse data.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and versatile Senior Artist / Graphic Designer with strong artistic fundamentals and the ability to work across a wide range of visual styles. In this role, you will produce bold, expressive, and character-driven visuals while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and execution. This position requires a balance of artistic creativity and technical precision, with a strong focus on generating dynamic visual assets, adapting quickly to diverse briefs, and documenting creative workflows in a structured manner.


Job Responsibilities

  • Professional Experience: Hand-on experience as a Cartoonist, Illustrator, Visual Artist, or in a similar professional role.
  • Artistic Fundamentals: Solid understanding of composition, color theory, lighting, line work, textures, and visual balance.
  • Tool Proficiency: Mastery of digital art software including Procreate, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Photoshop.
  • Style Versatility: Proven ability to adapt, replicate, and maintain consistency across diverse art styles, such as:
  • Cartoon & Comic Art
  • Manga & Anime
  • Pop Art
  • Sticker Style
  • Sketching & Drawing
  • Execution & Communication: Exceptional portfolio showcasing visual versatility, strong written and verbal communication skills, high attention to detail, and efficient time management in meeting tight deadlines.


Required Qualification:

In this role, you will be responsible for building high-quality visual content and defining artistic standards. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Asset Creation: Producing high-quality illustrations and visual assets based on detailed creative briefs.
  • Character & Graphic Design: Developing character-driven and graphic visuals across multiple styles (cartoon, manga/anime, pop art, sticker designs, and sketching).
  • Style Consistency: Producing multiple asset variations while ensuring strict consistency in style, composition, line work, and color balance.
  • Workflow & Metadata Documentation: Documenting artistic prompts, design workflows, and asset metadata in a clear, structured manner.
  • Collaboration & Iteration: Working closely with cross-functional teams, incorporating calibration feedback efficiently, and refining visual outputs.


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Illustration, Visual Communication, or a related creative field.
  • A comprehensive portfolio demonstrating a strong track record in multi-style digital illustration and asset creation.


Project Snapshot

  • Estimated earning potential of approximately $7hour.
  • Upto 12 weeks remote project.
  • Up to 40 hours/week; part-time artists working up to 20 hours/week are welcome
  • Paid in USD
  • Start after portfolio approval and onboarding.


Evaluation Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • Post portfolio review final selected candidates will be contacted with the next steps and onboarding requirements.

Turing is an AI-powered tech services company with a mission to accelerate AGI advancement and deployment by bridging the gap between global talent from 100+ countries and the world's best foundational LLM companies, by helping them improve performance through model evaluation, fine-tuning, feedback, factuality and handling diverse data.


Role Overview

We are seeking creative and detail-oriented Digital Imaging Specialist/Digital Artists and 3D Artists who can create high-quality stylized assets from briefs and references. The ideal candidate should have strong skills in 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, shading, rendering, and material creation.


Project Snapshot

  • Estimated earning potential of approximately $7/hour
  • 12 weeks remote project
  • Up to 40 hours/week; part-time artists working up to 20 hours/week are welcome
  • Paid in USD
  • Start after portfolio approval and onboarding


What You’ll Do

  • Create stylized 3D models and digital assets.
  • Work with low-poly, voxel, handcrafted, and material-driven styles.
  • Recreate textures such as clay, fabric, paper, and textiles.
  • Apply strong skills in topology, UV mapping, lighting, shading, and rendering.
  • Produce consistent variations and optimize assets for production.
  • Document workflows and incorporate feedback.


Requirements

  • Freshers, emerging Digital artists, and experienced professionals are welcome.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing stylized 3D work and material exploration.
  • Proficiency in Blender, ZBrush, Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects, 3ds Max, or Cinema 4D.
  • Familiarity with relevant plugins and scripts.
  • Understanding of NPR workflows, visual storytelling, and asset optimization.
  • Strong communication, attention to detail, and time-management skills.


What’s Next?

  • Submit your application and portfolio. Shortlisted candidates will undergo a portfolio review before onboarding.

title: Instrutor de Treinamento (Automotivo) - Freelancer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em Vendas no segmento automotivo para atuar no desenvolvimento de conteúdos e na condução de treinamentos voltados às operações comerciais da rede de concessionárias, garantindo profundidade técnica, aplicação prática e impacto nos resultados de vendas.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento da área de Vendas.
  • Ministrar treinamentos presenciais e virtuais para equipes comerciais, lideranças e profissionais que atuam na jornada de vendas da concessionária.
  • Traduzir conceitos estratégicos e processos comerciais em conteúdos claros, objetivos e aplicáveis à realidade do negócio.
  • Desenvolver treinamentos voltados para prospecção, qualificação de clientes, gestão de leads, negociação, técnicas de vendas, conversão e fidelização.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências de liderança comercial, gestão de equipes e melhoria contínua dos indicadores de performance.
  • Acompanhar tendências, processos e melhores práticas do mercado automotivo e de vendas consultivas, garantindo a atualização contínua dos conteúdos de treinamento.
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos programas de aprendizagem, promovendo engajamento, qualidade e impacto nos resultados comerciais.
  • Atuar como parceiro consultivo junto às áreas de negócio, identificando necessidades de treinamento, oportunidades de desenvolvimento e iniciativas para aumento de performance comercial.
  • Desenvolver conteúdos alinhados às necessidades específicas da rede de concessionárias, garantindo aplicabilidade prática às rotinas e desafios da operação de vendas.
  • Incorporar conceitos e boas práticas de experiência do cliente nos programas de treinamento, fortalecendo o relacionamento e a jornada comercial.
  • Facilitar workshops, dinâmicas e discussões estruturadas que promovam troca de experiências, fortalecimento das competências comerciais e desenvolvimento de lideranças.
  • Demonstrar profundo entendimento dos processos de vendas automotivas, utilizando linguagem adequada ao público-alvo e abordando desafios, oportunidades e melhores práticas do segmento.
  • Conectar pessoas, processos, indicadores e estratégias comerciais, proporcionando uma experiência de aprendizagem relevante e alinhada aos objetivos da rede de concessionárias.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa.
  • Sólido conhecimento em processos, indicadores e estratégias de vendas no segmento automotivo.
  • Experiência em concessionárias automotivas, especialmente nas áreas de Vendas, Gestão Comercial e Atendimento ao Cliente.
  • Conhecimento sobre gestão de leads, funil de vendas, negociação, relacionamento com clientes e performance comercial.
  • Vivência na condução de treinamentos e desenvolvimento de conteúdo para equipes comerciais e lideranças.
  • Habilidade para facilitar treinamentos e promover aprendizagem de forma prática, dinâmica e engajadora.
  • Capacidade de conectar aspectos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para gerar impacto nos resultados de vendas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo.
  • Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem.
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais de treinamento.
  • Certificações ou formações relacionadas a vendas consultivas, negociação ou liderança comercial.


Competências Comportamentais

  • Comunicação e influência.
  • Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Protagonismo e senso de dono.
  • Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos.
  • Orientação para resultados.
  • Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade.
  • Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset).


Perfil Desejado

Profissional apaixonado pelo desenvolvimento de pessoas e pela evolução dos resultados de vendas, com forte visão comercial e conhecimento do mercado automotivo. Deve ser capaz de atuar como facilitador, consultor e instrutor, compreendendo profundamente a realidade das concessionárias e transformando desafios comerciais em oportunidades de aprendizagem. Espera-se que contribua para o fortalecimento das competências da força de vendas, aumento da performance comercial, melhoria da experiência do cliente e crescimento sustentável dos resultados da rede de concessionárias.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Oportunidade para um(a) professora(a) de alemão, que busca trabalhar de forma remota e flexível, se desprendendo do método tradicional de ensino e impactando positivamente na vida de centenas de alunos e alunas.


Buscamos um profissional paciente, responsável e proativo. Não é necessário ter experiência.


Tipo de contratação: PJ;

Nível de proficiência: B2 ou acima.

Horário: a combinar.

Salário: a combinar.

Local: Remoto.


Atividades principais:

• Aulas de Conversação e Plantões de Dúvidas, conforme metodologia do curso.


Requisitos Necessários:

• Proficiência de Nível B2 ou acima.

• Experiência intermediária com pacote Office.

• Agilidade;

• Boa comunicação.

• Paciência;


Habilidades Diferenciais (mas não obrigatórias):

• Graduado(a) ou graduando(a) em Letras.

• Experiência com viagens/intercâmbio para países falantes de alemão;

• Experiência com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais.


Quem Somos:

A GC Ensino é uma empresa especializada em lançamentos digitais de infoprodutos, idealizadora da escola de alemão \"Missão Alemão\" e do curso \"Programa Deutsch Pro\".


Isso significa que transformamos vidas através do conhecimento!


Nosso papel é promover a educação e impactar positivamente milhares de pessoas ao redor do mundo, através do idioma alemão. E tudo isso utilizando uma ferramenta que mudou a forma com que nós, seres humanos, nos comunicamos: a internet!


  • Gostou do nosso propósito e está interessado(a) em fazer parte do nosso time? Faça sua aplicação.

title: Project Management Officer
description:
Job Title: PMO Analyst

Location: Brazil – Remote

Employment Type: Contract (CST or EST Time Zone)


Job Summary

We are seeking a PMO Analyst with 3–6 years of experience supporting program and project management in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will maintain integrated project plans, manage RAID logs, build executive dashboards, and prepare steering committee materials.   • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to support weekly reporting cycles with high accuracy

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in the Life Sciences or Healthcare domain
  • Process standardization and continuous improvement
  • User adoption and localization support for Mexico operations

title: Freelancer  Gestão de Projetos Jr.
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Freelancer para Gestão de Projetos Jr. com foco em entregas de tecnologia e produtos digitais.


Atribuições:


● Auxiliar no planejamento e priorização do backlog através de reuniões semanais

com equipe interna, estimando esforço e, por fim, o fechamento da sprint semanal.

Em seguida, alinhamento da mesma com o cliente.

● Receber e entender o briefing do cliente e, a partir disso, verificar a necessidade do

debriefing. Disseminar o briefing recebido para as demais áreas, através de reunião

de kickoff com toda a equipe necessária.

● Atualizar, controlar e mapear as atividades do time, reportando sempre a gestão as

atividades e entregas da semana.

● Garantir que os processos sejam respeitados, e as plataformas (internas e do

cliente) estejam sempre atualizadas e fazer com que os prazos pré acordados sejam

atendidos.

● Garantir que as entregas estejam de acordo com o briefing, fazendo a validação

interna antes de dividir com o cliente.

● Manter boa comunicação e transparência com cliente e áreas internas;

● Participar ativamente das atividades, discussões e cerimônias de gestão (daily,

planning, review).

● Organizar e alinhar a rede e seus materiais, acompanhando sempre se as entregas

estão sendo colocadas nessa plataforma.


Requisitos


● Familiaridade com ferramentas de metodologia ágil;

● Conhecimentos em keynote, excel e power point;

● Aptidão com ambiente digital e tecnologias;

● Aptidão para resolução de problemas;

● Excelente habilidade de comunicação.



Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica

Duração de 90 dias

Remoto

title: Analista de Farmacovigilância - Sênior
description:
Oportunidade para atuar na Libbs empresa brasileira consolidada do segmento Farmacêutico.

Segue abaixo informações da posição:


Tipo de Vaga: Temporário - Projeto por tempo determinado.

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda a sexta - Horário flexível entrada das 07:00 ás 09:00 e saída das 16:00 ás 18:00;

Local de Trabalho: Brasil

Modelo de Atuação: 100% Home office.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ FAZER:

• Atuar na avaliação e monitoramento de dados de segurança de medicamentos comercializados, assegurando o cumprimento das regulamentações nacionais e internacionais de Farmacovigilância.

•Conduzir avaliações de segurança, análises de tendência, detecção de sinais e apoiar a elaboração de avaliações benefício-risco dos produtos.

•Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e implementação de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e fluxos relacionados ao Sistema de Farmacovigilância.

•Participar de projetos estratégicos relacionados ao desenvolvimento de novos produtos, contribuindo com avaliações de segurança e definições de processos de farmacovigilância.

•Atuar junto a parceiros externos e empresas parceiras, garantindo alinhamento técnico, troca de informações e cumprimento dos acordos de farmacovigilância.

•Contribuir para a elaboração de avaliações benefício-risco, análises de segurança e atividades de detecção de sinais.

•Apoiar auditorias, inspeções regulatórias e processos de due diligence relacionados à área.

•Participar da estruturação e melhoria contínua dos processos de farmacovigilância, promovendo qualidade, rastreabilidade e confiabilidade dos dados.

•Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas e demandas relacionadas aos projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

O QUE É NECESSÁRIO:

• Formação: Ensino superior completo em Farmácia ou áreas correlatas da Saúde

• Experiência: Em avaliação e gerenciamento de casos de segurança e atividades de monitoramento de segurança de medicamentos.

Vivência em gestão de projetos, implantação ou melhoria de processos.

Experiência em interação com áreas multidisciplinares e parceiros externos.

Conhecimento das regulamentações nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis às Boas Práticas de Farmacovigilância (RDC 406/2020, GVP, ICH e demais normas aplicáveis).

• Inglês avançado - conversação.

Caso tenha interesse, disponibilidade e requisitos necessários, finalize sua candidatura!

O Grupo Soulan Recursos Humanos espera contribuir em breve com sua trajetória profissional.

title: Digital Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a process-oriented, analytical, and detail-oriented Digital Operations Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will work closely with the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director to provide analytical support across the company. You will also support digital operations. 


Role Responsibilities

Analytics :

  • Analyze e-commerce performance, including orders, conversion rates, revenue, customer behavior, and product performance 
  • Monitor and analyze digital operations across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, and internal platforms
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, and Leadership to track KPIs and solve operational issues
  • Run cost benefit analysis of various workstreams
  • Analyze project and campaign performance
  • Support the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director in various ad-hoc analyses to support business decisions and strategic projects


Digital and E-commerce Operations:

  • Manage the sort of products on our website.
  • Project management of workstreams that are interdepartmental in nature
  • Manage analytics related audits of digital operations


Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English
  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics or related field 
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of E-commerce platforms and website maintenance.
  • Deep experience working with Google Sheets or Excel is required.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Better Together: We believe in contributing creatively and openly, helping others, and championing our people and customers.
  • Owner’s Mindset: We work diligently, seek out problems, take a bias for action, and own our mistakes.
  • Quality and Craftsmanship: We take pride in what we do and value quality in our work and products. 
  • Process Orientation: We show our work, think ahead, and seek continuous improvement. 
  • Moving Quickly: We are proactive people who take initiative and get things done in a timely manner.
  • Doing the Right Thing: We act with integrity and own our actions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a process-oriented, analytical, and detail-oriented Digital Operations Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will work closely with the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director to provide analytical support across the company. You will also support digital operations. 


Role Responsibilities

Analytics :

  • Analyze e-commerce performance, including orders, conversion rates, revenue, customer behavior, and product performance 
  • Monitor and analyze digital operations across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, and internal platforms
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, and Leadership to track KPIs and solve operational issues
  • Run cost benefit analysis of various workstreams
  • Analyze project and campaign performance
  • Support the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director in various ad-hoc analyses to support business decisions and strategic projects


Digital and E-commerce Operations:

  • Manage the sort of products on our website.
  • Project management of workstreams that are interdepartmental in nature
  • Manage analytics related audits of digital operations


Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English
  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics or related field 
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of E-commerce platforms and website maintenance.
  • Deep experience working with Google Sheets or Excel is required.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Better Together: We believe in contributing creatively and openly, helping others, and championing our people and customers.
  • Owner’s Mindset: We work diligently, seek out problems, take a bias for action, and own our mistakes.
  • Quality and Craftsmanship: We take pride in what we do and value quality in our work and products. 
  • Process Orientation: We show our work, think ahead, and seek continuous improvement. 
  • Moving Quickly: We are proactive people who take initiative and get things done in a timely manner.
  • Doing the Right Thing: We act with integrity and own our actions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: (Sr.) Director, Regulatory Affairs (Brazil)
description:
We are partnered with a company that is seeking an experienced (Sr.) Director of Regulatory Affairs to lead the development and execution of global regulatory strategies supporting the clinical development and commercialization of innovative therapies. This individual will play a key role in regulatory planning, submission strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful interactions with global health authorities.


Responsibilites:

  • Develop and execute global regulatory strategies to support product development, clinical trials, and marketing approvals.
  • Provide regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams and ensure alignment with overall development and business objectives.
  • Lead the planning, preparation, authoring, and review of regulatory submissions to global health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, and other international agencies.
  • Support regulatory submissions across the product lifecycle, including INDs, CTAs, NDAs, BLAs, and MAAs.
  • Ensure regulatory documentation is accurate, complete, compliant with global regulatory requirements, and delivered within established timelines.
  • Monitor regulatory deliverables, identify potential risks, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to support submission timelines.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and regulatory operations to support submission planning, publishing, and document management activities.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of regulatory processes, document standards, submission workflows, and regulatory systems.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Master’s Degree in life sciences discipline preferred
  • 7+ years experience in drug development and regulatory affairs
  • Must have experience with regulatory submission documents

title: Remote Photo Editors
description:
About Turing

Turing is an AI-powered tech services company with a mission to accelerate AGI advancement and deployment by bridging the gap between global talent from 100+ countries and the world's best foundational LLM companies, by helping them improve performance through model evaluation, fine-tuning, feedback, factuality and handling diverse data.


Role Overview

We are looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Photo Editor who can transform raw images into polished, visually compelling content. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of color correction, retouching, composition, visual aesthetics, and brand consistency.


Project Snapshot:

  • Estimated earning potential of approximately $7/hour
  • 12 weeks remote project
  • Up to 40 hours/week; part-time artists working up to 20 hours/week are welcome
  • Paid in USD
  • Start after portfolio approval and onboarding


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create original artwork based on creative briefs, ensuring strong composition and visual consistency
  • Work across multiple styles and deliver required variations
  • Maintain color, texture, detailing, and overall visual execution as per given briefs
  • Document work clearly, including prompts and metadata
  • Collaborate with teams and incorporate feedback effectively from Style Expertise, Oil & Watercolor Painting, Paper Art, Sketch & Drawing, Abstract & Geometric Art, Pop Art, Mixed Medium


Tools required:

  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Procreate
  • Adobe Illustrator


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience as a Digital Artist, Photo Editor, or in a similar role. (Fresher from design schools can also apply)
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating versatility across multiple visual styles and editing techniques.
  • Solid understanding of composition, color theory, lighting, and visual balance.
  • Ability to enhance, retouch, and manipulate images with precision and creativity.
  • Proven ability to adapt to and accurately replicate diverse visual styles.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a strong focus on quality and consistency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time-management skills and the ability to meet deadlines.


What’s Next?

  • Submit your application and portfolio. Shortlisted candidates will undergo a portfolio review before onboarding.

title: Value Consultant
description:
About the engagement

Allari, an IT services firm, is running a NetSuite fit assessment for a mid-market consumer products company that sells through major retailers and Amazon. We are looking for a Value Consultant to build the total cost of ownership analysis and the business case behind the assessment's recommendation.


What you will do

You will turn NetSuite's licensing structure and the solution architect's sizing into a defensible, subscription-inclusive, multi-year cost model, benchmark it against the client's current on-premise ERP, and shape the result into an executive business case.


Responsibilities

  • Build a subscription-inclusive, multi-year NetSuite total cost of ownership model, covering the base platform, seats by type, modules, SuiteCloud Plus, sandbox, and connectors
  • Model implementation, integration, and ongoing operation costs, including run-rate and annual escalation
  • Build the comparison baseline for staying on the current ERP, on the same basis and time horizon
  • Identify and price automation and AI capabilities that carry additional licensing
  • Collect and normalize non-binding budgetary implementation estimates from qualified resources
  • Assemble an executive business case that supports the recommendation


Required experience

  • Experience in ERP value consulting or value engineering, or in ERP total-cost and business-case development
  • Working knowledge of NetSuite licensing and pricing structure: editions, user and seat types, modules, and options
  • Strong financial-modeling skills and the ability to build clear, defensible cost models
  • Ability to present a business case to executive stakeholders


Preferred

  • NetSuite value-engineering or pre-sales value-consulting background
  • Consumer products, retail, or wholesale-distribution experience
  • Experience comparing SaaS ERP against on-premise total cost


Engagement terms

  • Contract role, remote
  • Independent contractor, engaged directly by Allari
  • Competitive contract rate, commensurate with experience


How to apply: Apply here with your resume in English.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ


Buscamos por um(a) Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) para atuar na concepção e evolução de produtos digitais, contribuindo para a criação de experiências intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário.


Responsabilidades

– Liderar a concepção e evolução de interfaces e experiências digitais, garantindo usabilidade, consistência e geração de valor para o usuário.

– Estruturar fluxos, jornadas e navegação dos produtos, proporcionando experiências intuitivas e eficientes.

– Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Product Managers, times de Engenharia e demais stakeholders.

– Criar wireframes, fluxos, protótipos e especificações de UI.

– Validar soluções por meio de testes de usabilidade e análise do comportamento dos usuários.

– Apresentar e defender decisões de design junto a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Requisitos

– Experiência comprovada como Product Designer, UX Designer ou UI Designer em produtos digitais.

– Experiência com UX/UI e desenvolvimento de experiências centradas no usuário, considerando usabilidade e boas práticas de design.

– Experiência na criação de fluxos, jornadas e protótipos de média e alta fidelidade.

– Domínio de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e prototipação.

– Conhecimento em Design Systems e trabalho com componentes reutilizáveis.

– Boa comunicação e capacidade de apresentar e defender decisões de design junto a diferentes stakeholders.

– Inglês avançado.

title: LLM Annotator - Portuguese
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly motivated LLM Annotators to support the evaluation and improvement of cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs). In this role, you will analyze structured data, create challenging prompts, evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy and reasoning quality, and provide evidence-backed feedback to improve model performance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create challenging prompts that evaluate an LLM's ability to retrieve, analyze, and reason over structured data.
  • Assess AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, logical reasoning, and completeness.
  • Identify model failures, inconsistencies, hallucinations, and reasoning gaps.
  • Validate model outputs using provided datasets and supporting evidence.
  • Document findings with clear, evidence-based explanations.
  • Consistently follow annotation guidelines and maintain high-quality standards.


Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in Potuguese .
  • Master's degree or higher in any discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional, research, or teaching experience.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to validate information against source data.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 3 options of time commitment: 20 hrs/week, 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisting based on qualifications and relevant professional writing work experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an analytical challenge (approximately 45 minutes) and a writing assessment (approximately 30 minutes).

title: Consultor(a) Júnior de Soluções | Pré-Vendas Técnico
description:
🚀 Sobre a Sinergis


Somos uma consultoria especializada em ClickUp e outras ferramentas de produtividade, ajudando empresas a transformarem seus processos de trabalho. Trabalhamos com clientes de diversos segmentos, desde startups até grandes corporações, desenhando soluções sob medida que geram resultado real. Se você curte tecnologia, organização e quer crescer rápido em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia e aprendizado constante, essa vaga foi feita pra você.


Sobre a Oportunidade


Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) Júnior de Soluções para integrar nosso time Comercial, atuando na frente de pré-vendas técnico .


Você será o elo entre o time de vendas e a entrega técnica: vai acompanhar leads durante todo o funil comercial, participar de reuniões técnicas, montar demonstrações personalizadas e ajudar nossos clientes a enxergarem o valor real das soluções que oferecemos, principalmente no ClickUp .


Não precisa ser expert. Precisa ter curiosidade, vontade de aprender e facilidade pra se comunicar. A gente te desenvolve no resto. 


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com leads junto ao time comercial, entendendo processos, dores e necessidades de cada potencial cliente.
  • Montar Provas de Conceito (PoC) : criar demonstrações customizadas no ClickUp (e outras ferramentas) mostrando como a solução resolve o problema real do cliente.
  • Acompanhar períodos de teste (Trial) : garantir que o lead tenha a melhor experiência durante os testes, tirando dúvidas e ajudando na configuração inicial.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as negociações: ajudar a quebrar objeções técnicas e validar a viabilidade do que está sendo proposto.
  • Qualificar oportunidades : identificar se o cliente tem fit com nossas soluções e como podemos gerar mais valor.
  • Estudar e se atualizar constantemente sobre ClickUp , produtividade e metodologias de gestão.


✅ O que você precisa ter


  • Conhecimento em ClickUp : não precisa ser avançado, mas você precisa conhecer a ferramenta, já ter usado em projetos reais e ter curiosidade pra se aprofundar.
  • Boa comunicação : saber se expressar com clareza em reuniões, ter escuta ativa e conseguir traduzir coisas complexas em linguagem simples.
  • Noções de gestão de projetos : entender conceitos básicos de métodos ágeis (Kanban, Scrum), fluxos de trabalho e organização de processos.
  • Perfil investigativo : gostar de fazer perguntas, entender problemas e pensar em soluções, mesmo quando o cliente não sabe explicar exatamente o que precisa.
  • Organização e autonomia : capacidade de gerenciar suas próprias demandas e acompanhar múltiplos leads simultaneamente.


⭐ Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Certificações do ClickUp (ClickUp Expert, Admin, etc.)
  • Experiência com Monday.com, Notion ou outras ferramentas de produtividade
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • Experiência anterior com consultoria, implantação de sistemas ou suporte técnico
  • Noções de vendas B2B (funil de vendas, qualificação de leads, jornada do cliente)
  • Ter estruturado algum projeto ou workspace complexo no ClickUp


O que oferecemos

﻿

  • Crescimento acelerado : você vai aprender diretamente com especialistas e terá acesso a treinamentos internos constantes.
  • Exposição a diferentes negócios : cada cliente é um case novo, você vai conhecer dezenas de operações e mercados diferentes.
  • Trabalho 100% remoto : flexibilidade total de localização.
  • Ambiente colaborativo : time pequeno, próximo, sem burocracia, onde sua opinião importa desde o dia 1.
  • Evolução rápida : possibilidade real de crescer para Consultor Pleno e Sênior conforme seu desenvolvimento.


Obs: Se possível, inclua um breve relato (texto ou vídeo de até 2 min) sobre: Um projeto ou fluxo que você já montou/organizou no ClickUp OU por que você acredita que seria um bom fit para essa posição.

  • Apoiar tecnicamente as negociações: ajudar a quebrar objeções técnicas e validar a viabilidade do que está sendo proposto.
  • Qualificar oportunidades : identificar se o cliente tem fit com nossas soluções e como podemos gerar mais valor.
  • Estudar e se atualizar constantemente sobre ClickUp , produtividade e metodologias de gestão.


✅ O que você precisa ter


  • Conhecimento em ClickUp : não precisa ser avançado, mas você precisa conhecer a ferramenta, já ter usado em projetos reais e ter curiosidade pra se aprofundar.
  • Boa comunicação : saber se expressar com clareza em reuniões, ter escuta ativa e conseguir traduzir coisas complexas em linguagem simples.
  • Noções de gestão de projetos : entender conceitos básicos de métodos ágeis (Kanban, Scrum), fluxos de trabalho e organização de processos.
  • Perfil investigativo : gostar de fazer perguntas, entender problemas e pensar em soluções, mesmo quando o cliente não sabe explicar exatamente o que precisa.
  • Organização e autonomia : capacidade de gerenciar suas próprias demandas e acompanhar múltiplos leads simultaneamente.


⭐ Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Certificações do ClickUp (ClickUp Expert, Admin, etc.)
  • Experiência com Monday.com, Notion ou outras ferramentas de produtividade
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • Experiência anterior com consultoria, implantação de sistemas ou suporte técnico
  • Noções de vendas B2B (funil de vendas, qualificação de leads, jornada do cliente)
  • Ter estruturado algum projeto ou workspace complexo no ClickUp


O que oferecemos

﻿

  • Crescimento acelerado : você vai aprender diretamente com especialistas e terá acesso a treinamentos internos constantes.
  • Exposição a diferentes negócios : cada cliente é um case novo, você vai conhecer dezenas de operações e mercados diferentes.
  • Trabalho 100% remoto : flexibilidade total de localização.
  • Ambiente colaborativo : time pequeno, próximo, sem burocracia, onde sua opinião importa desde o dia 1.
  • Evolução rápida : possibilidade real de crescer para Consultor Pleno e Sênior conforme seu desenvolvimento.


Obs: Se possível, inclua um breve relato (texto ou vídeo de até 2 min) sobre: Um projeto ou fluxo que você já montou/organizou no ClickUp OU por que você acredita que seria um bom fit para essa posição.

title: Editor de Vídeo (Remoto)
description:
Editor de Vídeo

Vaga Remota | porém morar em Blumenau ou região


Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo que já tenha vivência na área para dar ritmo e narrativa aos nossos conteúdos! 

Se você tem experiência em edição, sabe contar uma história com corte, trilha e motion, e tem interesse ou alguma vivência em captação (câmera, luz, áudio), seu lugar é aqui.


O que esperamos de você?

  • Captação: Operar câmeras, configurar iluminação e garantir a qualidade do áudio em gravações de estúdio e externas.
  • Edição: Editar e pós-produzir vídeos educacionais, garantindo qualidade e fluidez no conteúdo.
  • Motion Graphics: Criar letterings, transições e animações básicas para elevar o nível das produções.
  • Sound Design: Ajustar áudio, iluminação e efeitos especiais conforme necessário.
  • Curadoria: Auxiliar na decupagem de materiais e organização de arquivos (asset management).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com roteiristas e designers para alinhar o vídeo com a identidade visual e didática da empresa.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre novas tendências, ferramentas de edição de vídeo e uso de IA no dia a dia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Experiência prévia consolidada em edição de vídeos (perfil junior/pleno).
  • Domínio de softwares de edição como Adobe Premiere, After Effects , entre outros. (não conta CapCut)
  • Interesse ou vivência inicial em captação (câmera, iluminação, áudio) é esperado.
  • Conhecimento de animação e motion graphics é um diferencial.
  • Boa compreensão de narrativa visual e ritmo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e cumprir prazos com autonomia.


A jornada de trabalho é de segunda a sexta-feira, e ocorre de forma remota, porém, devido aos trabalhos de captação de vídeos é necessário morar em Blumenau ou regiões próximas e ter disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role — it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base, while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do


  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation

What You Bring


  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice

This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


Please review our \"Legal and Privacy Policy\" for details on how we handle your data:
