title: Customer Success
description:
About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.
  • Compliance Support
  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

US and International entity compliance)

  • Help complete orders for compliance related services such as business formations and

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail
  • Experience supporting onboarding or implementation processes for software products


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will play a key role in shaping how an ambitious startup design partner communicates its value to the world.

Today, our biggest bottleneck is not delivery — it’s clarity. We are looking for someone who can help sharpen our story, accelerate our sales process, and build unmistakable positioning in a highly competitive market.

  • You’ll work directly with founders, influence business strategy, and have meaningful ownership over how Foundey grows, communicates, and wins clients.

title: Talent Management
description:
Sobre a Flint

A Flint é um selo de edutainment que transforma educação em influência e influência em negócio. Criamos programas que misturam conteúdo, comunidade e inteligência aplicada para capacitar profissionais e empresas a usarem a linguagem das redes como ferramenta estratégica. 

Nossos projetos combinam storytelling, prática e pertencimento, com formatos digitais, linguagem viva e experiências pensadas para quem aprende fazendo. Trabalhamos com grandes marcas e criadores para transformar conhecimento em impacto real, ampliando vozes, repertórios e oportunidades


Sobre a posição

Na Flint, creators são parte central de muitos dos projetos que construímos para grandes marcas. Trabalhamos com diferentes perfis de talentos, creators independentes, empresários e agências, conectando essas relações a campanhas, conteúdos, experiências e projetos de longo prazo. Estamos procurando uma pessoa para assumir a frente de Talent Management , cuidando da relação entre a Flint e nosso ecossistema de creators e agências parceiras.


Essa pessoa será responsável por fazer a ponte entre Flint, creators, agências de talentos e nossos projetos para clientes , garantindo que toda essa relação aconteça de forma organizada, ágil e positiva.

title: Web Researcher
description:
Web Research Specialist - 8-week paid contract, remote (US)

8 weeks, full-time, remote. 40 hours/week with ~$20/hour. ~ around $6,400 for the full contract.


What you'll actually do:

Work with a frontier AI model - you'll help train it, test it, and make it smarter.

Think prompt engineering meets research: you talk to the AI, find where it gets stuck, and help fix that. No coding needed.


You're a fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years of research experience - you've dug through government databases, archives, registries, court records, PDFs
  • Cite the exact page, table, or section
  • Can pick up a topic you know nothing about and get to the bottom of it
  • Write clear, native-level English
  • Don't mind heavy documentation - the evidence trail is most of the work


Backgrounds we're looking for: reference librarians and archivists, investigative journalists and fact-checkers, OSINT / due diligence / KYC researchers, patent and legal-discovery searchers, genealogists, trivia and puzzle-hunt writers.


Bonus points: experience with LLM evaluation or red-teaming, comfort with JSON.


The details:

  • Contract, pay per task - no benefits or paid leave
  • 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours overlapping Pacific time
  • 8 weeks, starting ASAP
  • Hiring process: quick intro call → short assessment (Google Form) → review.


Sounds like you? Apply - it takes two minutes.

title: Advogado(a) Tributário Pleno
description:
Advogado(a) Tributário Pleno — Belém/PA


—


Escritório jurídico multidisciplinar em Belém.


Atuação direta em direito tributário: planejamento e escolha de regime, recuperação de créditos, pareceres, defesas administrativas nas três esferas e contencioso judicial.


A matéria tributária é conduzida de ponta a ponta pelo mesmo advogado. O atendimento ao cliente é direto.


Alguém que responde tributário sem separar consultivo de contencioso.

Que sustenta na defesa a tese que escreveu no parecer.

Que decide o regime com o empresário na mesa.

Que não precisa de um sênior entre si e a autuação.


—


Requisitos:


↳ OAB ativa

↳ Pós-graduação em Direito Tributário ou área correlata

↳ Experiência consolidada em tributário consultivo e contencioso

↳ Defesas administrativas (federal, estadual e municipal) e execuções fiscais

↳ Belém — presencial


Remuneração: R$ 3.650 a R$ 4.150 (associado), conforme enquadramento.

title: Mid-Level Pharmacovigilance Analyst
description:
The Mid-Level Pharmacovigilance Analyst will manage the preparation and submission of RPBR/PBRER and PGR/RMP reports, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and supporting process improvements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review RPBR/PBRER and PGR/RMP reports independently.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely data collection and submission.
  • Perform quality checks and ensure accuracy of safety data.
  • Contribute to SOP updates and process optimization initiatives.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior team members.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field.
  • Advanced English for conversation.
  • 3-5 years of experience in pharmacovigilance or regulatory reporting.
  • Strong knowledge of global safety reporting requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in English (written and spoken).


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Tariff Analyst
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Tariff Analyst for Gigawatt's Tariff Configuration team, the group that turns published utility tariffs into logic our platform can bill on. This is not data entry. What this team produces is the substrate the product runs on, and it is what a utility is trusting when it puts our software in front of its own customers. This team sits in Product, not in services. Accuracy is not a quality attribute of this role; it is the deliverable.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own tariff analysis and extraction: Work through published tariff books and pull out everything that determines what a customer is charged, including riders and supplemental charges. Organize it into clear, consistent structured data.
  • Own configuration workbooks: Build detailed workbooks that translate written tariff rules into explicit formulas and structured logic: price times quantity, billing demand rules, minimum charges, seasonal variations, and conditional calculations.
  • Own the rules in our engine: Configure tariff and regulatory logic in our visual, node-based rule builder. This is not programming. It is decomposing a written rule into steps and conditions and wiring them together, much like building a multi-tab Excel model where every input traces to an output.
  • Work from requirements, not just documents: Some rules come from a published tariff. Others come from a regulatory order, a client's business requirements, or a written spec. Read all of them and decide how the rule should actually behave, including at the boundaries where documents are silent or contradict each other.
  • Own validation: Build and run test cases that prove each configuration produces the intended result. Validate calculations against different use cases before anything reaches a client. This is the part of the job that separates good work from work that looks good.
  • Own client implementations: Take a client's tariffs from source documents through to a working, tested configuration in the platform. Walk through completed configurations with the team and with clients, investigate discrepancies, and document open questions for follow-up. A tariff that does not make sense is usually a finding, not a mistake.
  • Own the reference data: Maintain organized records of attribute values, lookup tables, and other inputs the formulas depend on, and keep them consistent across configurations.
  • Make the tooling better: Review AI-assisted extraction output, flag where it goes wrong, and help define what a correct extraction looks like for each utility. Your corrections are the training signal.
  • Support system integration: Prepare structured tariff data for loading into our systems and work with engineers to identify and resolve data and configuration issues.
  • Wear many hats: This is an early team. Take on new areas of ownership as the work and the tooling evolve.


Qualifications


Must Have

  • Advanced Excel and analytical modeling: You are fast and precise with complex formulas, lookups, structured datasets, and models with many interdependencies. If you enjoy building financial models in Excel, you will likely be good at this, and it is the same instinct that makes someone good in our rule builder.
  • Analytical problem solving: You can read a long, detailed, poorly structured document and break the written rules inside it into clean calculations, conditions, and structured logic.
  • Attention to detail: You can work line by line through large amounts of information and find the inconsistencies, gaps, and calculation errors others miss. In this role that is not a personality trait, it is the control that keeps incorrect bills from reaching customers.
  • Strong reading and written English: You will read dense US legal and regulatory English every day and write clear notes, questions, and documentation in English. This is a higher bar than conversational fluency and it is what we screen hardest on.
  • Organization: You can hold multiple tariffs, workbooks, source documents, open questions, and revisions in flight without losing the thread or drifting from the standard.
  • Technical literacy: Comfortable with structured data, system fields, and lookups. You do not need to write code. Familiarity with formats such as JSON is a plus.
  • AI-assisted workflows: You use AI tools to speed up research, extraction, and drafting, and you independently verify what they give you rather than trusting it.


Nice to Have

  • Rule-based domains: Experience with utility tariffs, energy markets, regulatory documents, financial models, or other complex rule-based datasets.
  • Requirements to configuration: Experience translating legal, regulatory, or business requirements into structured data or system configurations.
  • Builder-style tools: Experience with any visual or low-code rule builder, workflow tool, or configuration-driven software.
  • Data fluency: Familiarity with database concepts and structured data formats.


Location

  • Remote, Brazil.


US Team is based on Eastern and Pacific standard times.

title: Estágio em UI/UX Design
description:
Somos uma HRtech, e nossa missão é tornar as relações trabalhistas mais simples, eficientes e justas!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa curiosa, colaborativa e com vontade de aprender para crescer com a gente!


Sua missão será poiar a criação e evolução das interfaces digitais da Nexti, contribuindo para experiências mais simples, intuitivas e alinhadas às necessidades dos nossos usuários. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender na prática, em parceria com os times de Design, Produto e Desenvolvimento.


🤓 Contamos com você para:

  • Apoiar a criação e melhoria de interfaces web e mobile, identificando problemas e oportunidades na experiência dos usuários;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de propostas de interfaces e protótipos, com orientação do time;
  • Participar das rotinas de Produto e Design, colaborando em reuniões, discussões e atividades de ideação;
  • Realizar benchmarks e pesquisas de referências para identificar boas práticas e possibilidades de melhoria;
  • Apoiar a documentação de processos, decisões e aprendizados dos projetos.


REQUISITOS INDISPENSÁVEIS

O que buscamos:

  • Estar cursando graduação ou curso superior em Design, Design Digital, Design Gráfico, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de design de interfaces (UI) e experiência do usuário (UX), adquirida em cursos, projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais;
  • Interesse em compreender as necessidades e os contextos dos usuários antes de propor soluções;
  • Clareza para comunicar ideias e disposição para colaborar com diferentes áreas;
  • Organização para lidar com atividades, informações e prioridades;
  • Proatividade, curiosidade e vontade de pesquisar, aprender e explorar novas referências.


✨ Será um diferencial:

Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de criação e prototipação de interfaces, preferencialmente Figma.


Sobre o portfólio:

Queremos conhecer sua forma de pensar e construir soluções! Seu portfólio não precisa ter projetos profissionais: projetos acadêmicos, pessoais ou estudos de caso que mostrem seu processo de design também são bem-vindos.

title: Remote Business Analyst - Portuguese
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways : Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?).
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?


Note : No other prior specialized domain experience is needed


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Think ing: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator,etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagemen t type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitment required: This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los Angeles

title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Senior Backend & AI Engineer – Newsroom Transformation #3137


The Mission

Join a global Newsroom Transformation team working at the intersection of backend engineering, AI, and modern journalism technology. You’ll build scalable backend services while helping integrate AI capabilities into news systems, including LLM orchestration, fine-tuning, RAG, and intelligent automation.


You’ll collaborate with engineering teams and global stakeholders across multiple regions, helping transform how AI and automation power the next generation of newsroom platforms.


The Role

  • Backend Engineering: Build and maintain scalable services using Node.js, TypeScript, and Express.js within a distributed microservices environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Develop AI-powered services using LangChain, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and model fine-tuning.
  • RAG & NLP: Design and maintain Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that ground AI outputs in trusted news content, with a strong understanding of embeddings and tokenization.
  • Model Strategy: Work with models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic, selecting the right model based on performance, capabilities, and cost.
  • MLOps & Observability: Monitor AI and backend performance, including latency, throughput, errors, model quality, bias, toxicity, and concept drift.
  • Distributed Systems: Build secure integrations across internal REST/gRPC APIs, third-party vendors, and microservices.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Containerize services with Docker, manage CI/CD through CircleCI, and support infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Global Collaboration: Work closely with distributed engineering teams and stakeholders, presenting technical solutions and contributing to a highly collaborative, asynchronous environment.


The \"Must-Haves\"

  • Backend Engineering: 5+ years of professional backend development experience, ideally within distributed or microservices environments.
  • Node.js / TypeScript: Strong hands-on expertise with Node.js, TypeScript, and Express.js.
  • Python: Basic to intermediate Python experience for AI/ML development and model-related tasks.
  • LangChain: Hands-on experience with LangChain is mandatory.
  • AI / LLMs: Strong understanding of NLP, tokenization, embeddings, prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and RAG architectures.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and at least one major cloud provider — Google Cloud preferred, AWS acceptable.
  • Microservices: Strong understanding of distributed and microservice architectures.
  • Global Collaboration: Comfortable working asynchronously across multiple time zones and collaborating with international stakeholders.


The \"Bonus\" Skills

  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform.
  • Legacy Technologies: Familiarity with PHP.
  • Media & Publishing: Experience working in media, publishing, journalism, or newsroom technology.
  • GTM Experience: Exposure to startup environments and Go-to-Market strategies.
  • Advanced MLOps: Experience with model evaluation, validation, monitoring, and production AI/ML pipelines.


Personal Traits

  • AI-Minded Engineer: Excited about applying LLMs and emerging AI technologies to real-world products and workflows.
  • Backend Problem Solver: Enjoys building reliable, scalable services and solving complex distributed-system challenges.
  • Pragmatic Technologist: Able to evaluate models, tools, and approaches based on technical requirements, quality, and cost.
  • Strong Communicator: Comfortable presenting ideas, explaining technical decisions, and working with stakeholders across different regions.
  • Self-Driven: Thrives in a remote, asynchronous environment and takes initiative without constant direction.
  • Global Collaborator: Enjoys working across cultures, time zones, and engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

title: Arquiteto de Dados | GCP & Salesforce Data Cloud
description:
Oportunidade: Arquiteto de Dados | GCP & Salesforce Data Cloud


Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados com sólida experiência em arquitetura de plataformas de dados em Google Cloud (GCP) e atuação em projetos de integração com Salesforce Data Cloud .


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Experiência com projetos de integração entre Google Cloud e Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Projetar arquiteturas para plataformas de dados escaláveis, resilientes e de alta disponibilidade.
  • Definir estratégias de integração entre Google Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Projetar soluções para ingestão, transformação, processamento e disponibilização de dados.
  • Integrar múltiplas fontes de dados, incluindo Salesforce/Data Cloud, sistemas corporativos, APIs, bancos de dados e outras fontes externas.
  • Definir e evoluir pipelines de dados e processos ETL/ELT.
  • Apoiar a definição de arquiteturas envolvendo Data Lake, Data Warehouse e demais componentes da plataforma de dados.
  • Projetar integrações utilizando APIs, REST e diferentes padrões de integração.
  • Definir modelos e estruturas de dados adequados aos diferentes casos de uso.
  • Garantir requisitos de qualidade, governança, segurança, escalabilidade e disponibilidade dos dados.
  • Avaliar tecnologias e padrões para evolução da plataforma de dados.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de arquitetura sustentáveis e escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Engineering, Cloud, Salesforce, Tecnologia, Produto e Negócio.
  • Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura de dados e sua integração com o ecossistema Salesforce.


Requisitos

  • Domínio em arquitetura e serviços de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), como BigQuery, Cloud Storage, orquestração de pipelines e gestão de identidade e acesso
  • Experiência no desenho e evolução de plataformas de dados em Cloud.
  • Conhecimento dos principais serviços e componentes de dados do Google Cloud e Salesforce Data Cloud
  • Experiência com integração de múltiplas fontes de dados e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência com ETL/ELT, pipelines de dados e Data Integration.
  • Conhecimento em Data Lake, Data Warehouse e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com APIs, REST e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em governança, segurança, qualidade e disponibilidade de dados.
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e orientadas ao negócio.


Diferencial:

  • Certificações Google e/ ou Salesforce


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação:

Contratação: PJ

Modelo de atuação: Remoto


Benefícios ATRA

️ ♂️ Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Estamos selecionando Professor(a) para integrar o corpo docente do Pós em Inteligência Artificial Aplicada aos Negócios , Pós-Graduação Lato Sensu com 360 horas e duração de 12 meses.


Buscamos um profissional de mercado com experiência prática em Inteligência Artificial aplicada aos negócios, estratégia empresarial, inovação e transformação digital , capaz de conectar conceitos de IA a desafios reais das organizações.


Valorizamos profissionais que tenham liderado ou participado da implementação de projetos de IA, transformação digital ou inovação em empresas.


Disciplinas:

  • IA na Prática: Fundamentos e Transformação Digital dos Negócios
  • Estratégia com IA: Vantagem Competitiva e Novos Modelos de Negócio
  • Liderando a Transformação: Change Management em Projetos de IA


Perfil desejado: experiência em AI Strategy, Transformação Digital, Estratégia, Inovação, Change Management e liderança de projetos de tecnologia/IA.


Perfis de interesse: Head of AI, AI Strategy Lead, Head of Innovation, Digital Transformation Lead/Director, AI Business Consultant, executivo de tecnologia/inovação.

title: VAGA 05 — Professor(a) de Pós-Graduação | IA Aplicada a Negócios, Marketing, Pessoas & Produtos
description:
Buscamos um(a) Professor(a) para Pós Graduação com visão multidisciplinar de negócios e experiência na aplicação prática de Inteligência Artificial em áreas corporativas .


O profissional deverá demonstrar como IA generativa, analytics e automação podem transformar Marketing, Vendas, Experiência do Cliente, Gestão de Pessoas e desenvolvimento de novos produtos.

As disciplinas abordam desde personalização, lead scoring, forecast e IA conversacional até People Analytics, recrutamento, inovação, produtos AI-first e novos modelos de monetização.


Disciplinas:

  • IA para Vender Mais: Marketing, Vendas e Experiência do Cliente
  • Pessoas e IA: People Analytics e Cultura de Inovação
  • Criando com IA: Produtos Inteligentes e Novos Modelos de Negócio


Perfil desejado: profissional com experiência em IA aplicada a negócios, transformação empresarial, inovação e implantação de soluções de IA em diferentes áreas corporativas.


Perfis de interesse: AI Business Consultant, AI Transformation Lead, AI Product Manager, Head of Product & AI, Digital Transformation Manager, AI Adoption Lead.


Diferenciais: experiência em Marketing/Vendas/CX, People Analytics, Product Management, Design Thinking ou Lean Startup.

title: Gestor de Mídia Paga Ecommerce
description:
• Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas de Meta Ads e Google Ads (Search, PMax, Shopping, Demand Gen)
  • Gerir um budget, com responsabilidade direta sobre ROAS, CAC e participação da mídia na receita;
  • Estruturar campanhas por estágio de funil e por produto/kit, e saber decidir o que é aquisição e o que é remarketing canibalizando venda orgânica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Design e Social na produção de criativos: briefar, testar em volume e matar rápido o que não performa
  • Garantir a saúde do rastreamento: pixel, CAPI, eventos de conversão, integração com a plataforma e checagem de discrepância entre plataforma, GA4 e o faturamento real
  • Reportar semanalmente com números que fecham com o DRE — margem de contribuição por canal, não só ROAS de plataforma
  • Reuniões diária com o time de marketing para alinhamentos e campanhas
  • Auxiliação em design e UX de landing pages e páginas de produto


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos gerindo mídia paga para e-commerce (obrigatório: e-commerce, não lead gen nem infoproduto)
  • Histórico comprovado de gestão de budget acima de R$100k/mês
  • Domínio real de Meta Ads Manager e Google Ads, incluindo estrutura de conta, segmentação e leitura de leilão
  • GA4, UTMs e atribuição — saber onde cada ferramenta mente
  • Excel/Sheets em nível de análise (não só de preenchimento)

title: Professor(a) de Pós-Graduação | Data Science, Machine Learning & Analytics
description:
Estamos selecionando Professor(a) para o Pós Graduação em Inteligência Artificial Aplicada aos Negócios , com atuação nas disciplinas relacionadas a Dados, Machine Learning e Analytics.


Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência prática em Data Science, Machine Learning, Estatística e Analytics , capaz de traduzir conceitos técnicos para aplicações reais de negócio.

O conteúdo envolve desde arquitetura e qualidade de dados até classificação, regressão, clusterização, séries temporais, métricas de modelos e estatística aplicada à tomada de decisão.


Disciplinas:

  • Dados que Valem Ouro: Fundamentos de Data & Analytics para Gestão
  • Machine Learning na Prática: Prevendo o Futuro do Negócio
  • Estatística para Decisão: Modelos Preditivos sem Complicação


Perfil desejado: experiência em Data Science, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, Estatística, Python e projetos reais de dados.


Perfis de interesse: Senior Data Scientist, Lead Data Scientist, Head of Data Science, Machine Learning Specialist/Engineer, Applied Scientist, Data Science Manager.

title: Clinical Data Validation Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Clinical Data Validation Engineer .


In this role you will:

As a Clinical Data Validation Engineer, you will work on Clinical Trial Reporting activities delivering listings and visualizations to support Clinical Trials. In addition, you will operate in compliance with SOPs and processes.


Responsibilities:

  • Delivery of data cleaning, study status metric, and monitoring reports and visualizations required per standard and study specific data review plans.
  • Deliverables.
  • TAU.
  • Study data.
  • Quality data.
  • Trial data and trial status information for cross-functional use and provide input on data management reporting standards as required.
  • Develop data cleaning reports in support of the data review plan, in collaboration with the Clinical Data Management and medical reviewers.


Mandatory Skills:

  • Previous related experience
  • Knowledge of Veeva CDB, JReview and Elluminate
  • Hands-on experience with report development in Elluminate preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Advanced or Fluent English

title: Program Manager
description:
Resources will support Indeed’s Application Security team by providing program management support for the Code Freshness (R&Ds) and Operational Ownership Expectations programs. Responsibilities include leading team meetings, creating project documentation, managing change initiatives, and providing overall program coordination and guidance.

Region: US - LATAM | Timezone: Any US-based timezone.


Requirements

Must-have skills:

  • Strong project management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work with PMO teams across the organization to track, report, and communicate progress, risks, blockers, and key results (KRs).
  • Experience setting up program meetings and communicating effectively with leadership and stakeholders. IQL/SQL and strong analytical skills.
  • Strong ability to work as a self-starter.
  • Proactively and independently researches, experiments, and solves problems with rapid iteration cycles to deliver results fast.


Nice-to-have skills:

  • Application Security domain knowledge (preferred).
